title: A concrete behavioral-delta target for cross-model mechanistic analysis
description: clozn.analysis.mech_target's output (MECH-CASE-00). The rule this artifact exists to enforce: mechanistic analysis (clozn.analysis.mechanistic_diff, causal_bisect, transplant) must never scan a model pair hunting for interesting activation differences -- it must start from a concrete, already-observed behavioral delta. This document IS that starting point: a specific answer/readout position, the reference and candidate token(s) observed there, both models' identity, and the clozn.pair-compatibility.v1 verdict that permitted building it in the first place. Two origins are supported (see `origin.kind`): a failed clozn.experiment.result.v0 cell (`experiment_cell`), or a per-token disagreement surfaced by diff-model's teacher-forced ladder (`diff_model_position`). This document is purely a TARGET -- it identifies where to look, and carries no causal claim about why the two models diverge there (that is a later slice's job, once it runs controlled interventions with controls; see clozn/analysis/mechanistic_diff.py's own 'purely observational' discipline, which this artifact's vocabulary matches).

model_ref.description: Identifying facts about one side of the pair, mirroring clozn.pair-compatibility.v1's own model_a/model_b (embedded verbatim as reference_model/candidate_model).

token_ref.description: One observed token. Both fields are optional and independently omitted (never null-padded) when not honestly known -- e.g. a run with no per-token trace carries a piece but no id.

answer_position.description: Where the behavioral delta is read off. 'token_index' is an absolute token position (prompt + continuation) suitable for clozn.analysis.mechanistic_diff's own position grid. 'final_response' is used when no single token position carries the delta (e.g. two experiment-cell responses are token-identical but a confidence/causal assertion still failed) -- the target then names the whole response as the readout, and 'note' explains why no narrower position applies.

origin_experiment_cell.description: Source #1: a failed clozn.experiment.result.v0 cell, compared against its own reference (baseline) variant's cell at the same (suite, case, seed) coordinate.

origin_diff_model_position.description: Source #2: one per-token disagreement position from diff-model's teacher-forced ladder (clozn.receipts.quant_receipts.diff_quant_scores' `positions` entries) -- a position where the reference and candidate models' own argmax disagreed on the SAME forced continuation.

anchor.description: which side generated/recorded the teacher-forced run this position came from

assertion.description: One clozn.testkit.runner.evaluate() assertion result (name/check/target/expected/actual/status/note) that did not pass on the candidate cell.

origin.description: Tagged by 'kind' -- exactly one of the two source shapes below.

behavioral_delta.description: What changed, and where -- in plain, non-causal, measured language (never 'caused'/'because'/'responsible for'/'localized'). 'failed_assertions' and 'response_diff' are experiment_cell-only; 'position_evidence' is diff_model_position-only; all three are omitted, never null, when not applicable to this target's origin.

position_evidence.description: The raw diff_quant_scores() position entry this target was built from, embedded verbatim.

pair_compatibility.description: The full clozn.pair-compatibility.v1 document that gated this target, embedded verbatim -- a stored target is self-describing about what compatibility was actually confirmed before it was built.
